name: agent-orchestrator
description: Delegate bounded coding tasks to local CLI agents, monitor them, and review their work from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Choose a CLI, model, and agent for delegated coding.
interface.longDescription: Codex plans bounded work, helps users choose a CLI, model, and internal agent, runs the selection as a background job, handles clarification questions, and reviews diffs and test evidence before accepting or requesting repairs.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose a CLI and model, then delegate this task.
Run this with Grok and my chosen model, then review it.
Show available coding agents, models, and active jobs.
